newsitem.title: UK: Lehman Brothers Commodities leaving LME floor.
newsitem.headline: Lehman Brothers Commodities leaving LME floor.

text.p: Lehman Brothers Commodities, a subsidiary of Lehman Brothers Holdings Inc, is to withdraw from the floor of the London Metal Exchange (LME) as soon as is possible, a company spokesman said on Thursday.
Lehman Brothers will no longer be a Category One LME ring-dealing member, but will retain LME clearing member status to service futures business, he said.
Exiting the floor of the LME follows Lehman's announcement on Wednesday that it is to wind down its existing business in metals and energy.
The metals and energy businesses employ around 35 people in London. Some of these will be let go at once, while others will be retained, closing out existing market positions, the spokesman said.
It was hoped that some of the staff involved would be reassigned within the company, he said.
Lehman's move follows a global review of its business, undertaken to focus the company on its core investment banking, equity and fixed income sales and trading areas.
